On Wed, Mar 6, 2019 at 10:24 AM Krystal Thomas <thomask...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello,
I'm trying to run a path analysis and I'm interested in how the model may differ by gender. How can I look at the fit indices and Rsquare output for each group? Currently, I'm only getting estimates and vaiiance for the individual groups. I've included the syntax I'm using below:

RQ2ModelOut3g<-sem(RQ2Model3, data=Diss, group="Gender_F14", missing="ML")
summary(RQ2ModelOut3g, rsquare=T, fit.measures=T)

Thanks!
